name: UK UZTM-Kartex (ООО УК «УЗТМ-Картэкс»)
note: Management company of the UZTM-Kartex group (Uralmashzavod, Uralmash - Gornoe Oborudovanie, IZ-Kartex). Gazprombank was the main shareholder of the group's enterprises from 2016 and lost control of the group in 2021; on 16 March 2022 a 51% stake passed to JSC Enlil Finance and 48.6% is held by the closed mutual fund ZPIF 'Gazprombank - industrial investments' (Kommersant, 30 June 2022). Enlil Finance's own shareholders are not public.
